'''Duraplex''' was a transparent material used in the windscreens of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], such as the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeders]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
